therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: radiotracer binding to PSMA protein for PET imaging
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: detection and localization of prostate cancer lesions via PSMA expression
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: number of primary prostate lesions detected on early dynamic 68Ga-PSMA-11 PET/CT imaging compared to mpMRI

results.effect_size: 68Ga-PSMA-11 PET/CT detected 24 primary lesions vs mpMRI detected 37 primary lesions
results.target_engagement_evidence: successful detection of PSMA-expressing lesions via PET imaging

context.comparator: mpMRI for primary lesions, CT/MRI for metastatic lesions
context.duration: up to 2 hours for imaging procedures
